name: MultiSelect
description:
Several choices from a list, shown as chips inside the field. Static options or an
async source. One line by default (overflow folds into "+N", its tooltip lists them);
`wrap` lets chips flow onto more lines in forms. Backspace in the empty input removes
the last choice; ← walks the chips.
signature: <V extends string = string>({ options, source, value, defaultValue, onValueChange, placeholder, size, width, wrap, icon, loading, empty, disabled, readOnly, required, invalid, name, id, onBlur, className, ref, ...aria }: MultiSelectProps<V>): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when a visible label does not name the control.

props.name: className
props.description: Layout only. Applied to the control box.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: empty
props.description: Content shown when there are no matching items.

props.name: icon
props.description: An icon element without an explicit size; the component sizes it through its tokens.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the control invalid. Pair it with an accessible validation message.

props.name: loading
props.description: Skeleton rows while static options load elsewhere.

props.name: name
props.description: The component’s name or native form field name, as specified by its value type.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when blur occurs. The callback type specifies its arguments.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when value change occurs. The callback type specifies its arguments.

props.name: options
props.description: A static list, filtered as you type.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while nothing is chosen.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Displays the current value without allowing edits.

props.name: ref
props.description: Receives the underlying element for focus or measurement. React 19 accepts ref as a normal prop.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field as required; pair it with the corresponding schema validation.

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.

props.name: source
props.description: Or search a server as you type.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value. Keep it in application state and update it in the change callback.

props.name: width
props.description: Content width: medium or full (default).

props.name: wrap
props.description:
Let chips wrap onto more lines (forms: growth the user caused). Off: one line that
folds the overflow into "+N" (toolbars, table filters, rows).
